QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Ciao, Until Next Time
QuestInfo.0: Now that you and Leon are on good terms, you should speak with him.
QuestInfo.1: Leon said he's leaving Berry to do some trading, and instructs you to meet him later in San Commerci.
QuestInfo.2: Leon gave you directions to San Commerci, and said he would meet you there later. You followed his directions and arrived in San Commerci, Commerci's capital.

npc.0: Okay, go east from the town, follow the coastal road, and you'll be in San Commerci in no time. It's a single road so you won't get lost, but be careful of thieves.\r\nI'll see you in #e#bSan Commerci#k#n!
